# xG24 per-channel registers (RAILtest RX, 39 MHz HFXO, BRD4187A)

Decoded from `raw/cap4.tar.xz` (RX on each channel, GSDK 4.5.0 RAILtest).
`SYNTH.VCOTUNING` is RAIL's calibration result for this die and
temperature, not a table value. RAIL tunes with `SYNTH.FREQ` and leaves
`CHCTRL` at 0 (`CHSP` is reused as bookkeeping); `FRC.WCNTCMP2` holds
`channel - 11` (RAIL bookkeeping, not used by the driver).
